description: This is a PHP source code file defining the EmployeeAllowedLicenseAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for retrieving allowed licenses for an employee within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class extends a generic Endpoint and implements collection functionality, including validation rules, service access, and handling of GET requests with search and pagination parameters.
